segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are cautioned by others to patch-test first since the formula can feel intense, but the one reviewer who explicitly describes her own skin as very sensitive reports no burning or irritation and got good peeling results within a week.

concerns.spots: Most reviewers report the oil fades dark spots, scars, or hyperpigmentation after three to seven days of consistent use, sometimes dramatically; however, a substantial number report the opposite effect, with skin turning darker or more discolored, including one reviewer who says it lightened her sister-in-law's skin but left new dark marks on her own, suggesting results vary by skin tone.
concerns.redness: Burning or tingling during and after use is commonly reported and usually described as temporary and tolerable, but at least one reviewer with very sensitive skin experienced no burning or irritation at all.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers report the treated skin becomes extremely dry, rough, or itchy in the days before peeling begins, severe enough that a couple of reviewers describe their skin as looking damaged or 'like a dead person's hands' during the process.

extraits.texte: I recently tried the peeling oil and unfortunately, my experience has been quite disappointing. From the very beginning, I followed all the instructions carefully, but the product turned out to be more water-based than anything else. After a week of use, I noticed no results, and even after two weeks, my skin had not improved at all. Instead of the promised benefits, I ended up with damage to my skin, which you can see in the images I’ve attached. The product did nothing to help with the dark marks I was hoping to reduce, and areas of my skin that I didn't even apply the oil to are still problematic. It's frustrating to see other customers satisfied with a product that did not work for me. I can only wonder if I received a defective version, as my experience was far from what was advertised. On a positive note, I did manage to return the product and received my refund, which is a relief. However, I can't recommend this peeling oil based on my experience.

I’ve been using the YAFUSIPE Yellow Peeling Oil for a little while now, and overall it’s just an okay product—there are some good things about it, but it’s not perfect. The biggest thing I noticed is that it does exfoliate pretty well. After a few days of consistent use, you can start to see some peeling, especially on areas like elbows, knees, or darker spots. It definitely feels like it’s working to remove dead skin and smooth things out over time. I also like that it can be used on different parts of the body, and the application process is pretty simple—just apply a thin layer and let it do its thing. The formula includes ingredients like salicylic acid and plant extracts, which are meant to help with exfoliation and skin texture. That said, it’s not a miracle product. The results aren’t super fast or dramatic, especially if you’re expecting major lightening or even skin tone quickly. It takes consistency, and even then the improvement is more gradual. Another thing to keep in mind is that it’s pretty strong. If you have sensitive skin, it might feel a bit intense or cause irritation if you’re not careful, so doing a patch test first is definitely a good idea. Overall, it’s a decent exfoliating treatment if you’re patient and use it correctly. It can help improve texture and gradually brighten certain areas, but it’s not a quick fix and may not work the same for everyone.

Listen, I was trying to lighten some dark spots/scars on my legs from an accident years ago. I applied 2-3 times a day and depending on the time I might have just went to bed without washing it off. It took at least 5 days for the peeling to start and the picture is 2 weeks in. It does work but wow does it dry out the skin so it can get somewhat itchy. Also I would NOT recommend putting this on your face even if it’s a mild peel.

It did peel my skins after 2 days but it also leave a darker spot. I let my sister in law tried it on her skin. And it also Perla hers and didn’t leave darker marks like it did for me. I guess it only work on some skin tones or people.

This product is AMAZING!!! At first I was very skeptical, but it works so well to my surprise. I only use this on my face 3 days out of each week since it can get very aggressive when Peeling. The reason I’m using this product is because I bought “faded topicals” to fade my stubborn hyperpigmentation and dark spots due to facial growth and acne (I have PCOS). However, the faded topicals cream made my hyperpigmentation/dark spots turn 2 shades darker and change in texture of my skin. I was disappointed and desperate. When I came across this product it was a game changer! So every week I alternate. For 3 days I use the oil overnight and the next week I’ll use it for 3 days and rinse off after 15 mins. By day 6 is when I noticed the peeling. Unfortunately, I wear makeup to cover up my hyperpigmentation, so I ended up using a razor to remove the dead skin that’s peeling off and my face feels super smooth and I have no damage to my skin. Within a week of use I see a huge difference in my skin. My skin is smooth, bright, and very plump. The ONLY downside is this product burns for 15-20 mins but then goes away. But overall, it works pretty well :) Btw the pictures you see are before and after of just one week using the product! I already see a huge improvement.

extraits.texte: I’ve been applying this oil to my hands for about 5–6 days, and my hands became SO dry. They literally looked like a dead person’s hands 😭😂 I was so nervous! Then around day 6–7, they finally started peeling. I was applying it 3 times a day, so I honestly couldn’t even go outside for almost a week because of how my hands looked. 😭 But overall, I really love the outcome! I’m definitely trusting the process because the results are already looking so good. ❤️✨

Follow the instructions and be patient. The only question I would love to ask is, when peeling, do I continue to apply oil? You can see my before and after pictures. No burning , no irritation and I have a very sensitive skin. I followed the instructions given and within a week I started noticing the peelings.
